verdict.rationale: Riveter is built around bulk work. An enrichment fills new columns across many input rows, and a single `/enrich` request accepts up to 10,000 rows. One request can also fan out, for example finding every dental practice in a city and then every dentist in each. Webhooks, dry-run credit estimates, max_credits caps and SDK polling and pagination support large batch runs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of large batch runs, and evidence of bulk management operations (bulk edit, delete or re-run) beyond enrichment and dataset generation.
